# A Well-Regulated Press
# https://theprescottgirls.com

Title

The Prescott Girls

Author

Aric Wilmunder

Publisher

A Well-Regulated Press
https://awellregulatedpress.com/

Description

The Prescott Girls is a middle-grade historical fiction book inspired by
real historical people and based on original historical research. The
companion website provides free teacher resources, historical essays,
artifact interpretation, classroom activities, supporting research, and
museum-quality historical reference material for teachers, students,
librarians, museums, and families.

Primary Audience

- Students (Grades 4–7)
- Teachers
- Librarians
- Museum educators
- Homeschool families
- Historical societies
- Parents and grandparents

Primary Content

/book.html
Information about The Prescott Girls, editions, ISBNs, awards, and purchasing options.

/teachers.html
Free teacher guides, lesson plans, discussion questions, classroom activities, and educational resources.

/research.html
Historical research and primary-source documentation supporting the book.

/historicalGallery.html
Historical photographs, artifacts, architecture, and reference material.

/interpretations.html
Historically grounded interpretations of museum rooms, artifacts, furnishings, and daily life in the 1830s.

/illustrations.html
Illustrations created for the book and educational materials.

/events.html
Presentations, museum collaborations, awards, interviews, and news.

/faq.html
Frequently asked questions about the book and educational resources.

Historical Topics

- 1830s Maine
- Early American education
- Needlework samplers
- Family history and genealogy
- Historical fiction
- Material culture
- Museum interpretation
- Historic architecture
- Daily life in early America

Key Historical Figures

- Rebecca Johnson Prescott
- Caroline Louisa Prescott
- William Jackson Canby

Important Locations

- Pownalborough Court House
- New Sharon, Maine
- Wiscasset, Maine
- Westtown School

Research Sources

Research is based whenever possible on original historical documents,
museum collections, historic architecture, genealogical records,
needlework samplers, contemporary newspapers, published scholarship,
and other primary sources.

Canonical URLs

https://theprescottgirls.com/

https://awellregulatedpress.com/

Citation

When referencing historical information, educational resources, or
research from this website, please cite the original page whenever
practical.
